resources.string: It\'s here. It IS this phone.
Its body came from this phone. Another phone, another body.
You can rename it any time in Settings.
It lives on this phone. Conversations stay here, memory is encrypted, and it remembers a fact only after you tap yes. The whole story: Settings → Why no internet.
A creature nobody looks at is a creature that fades. The widget puts it on your home screen — one still picture, no animation, no battery.
